user_query: I'm planning a road trip with my friends and we want to discover new music along the way. Can you suggest radio channels that play genres like alternative rock, reggae, and R&B?

TaskList.description: Find radio channels that play alternative rock, reggae, and R&B.
Filter the radio channels to only include those from the United States, Jamaica, and the United Kingdom.
Retrieve the cities where the filtered radio channels are based.
